reviewed_by: Codex focused review for the live chat-switch render crash
reason: The hotfix removes the transcript-height layout-effect feedback loop that can exceed React's nested update limit during rapid authoritative conversation replacement, retains content-visibility with a fixed intrinsic estimate, and treats superseded AbortError rejections as cancellations. One frontend case covers cancellation classification. Four permanent conversation-switch entries cover the regression journey in desktop Chromium, emulated mobile Chromium, emulated mobile WebKit, and real Core.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Python and native tests are empty because the hotfix changes only React rendering, browser diagnostics, CSS, and the existing Playwright journey. Unrelated providers, harness execution, missions, browser tooling, terminals, reports, packaging, migrations, and API contracts are excluded. Additional viewport profiles duplicate the same selected journey and were already green on the merged performance tranche. Physical-phone testing remains unavailable and will be reported separately.
